fixed_tolerance.scope: Independent post-run receipt reconstruction, no metric kernels rerun.

data_provenance.scope: Post-run provenance reconciliation added after benchmark start; not preregistration.
checks: actual ZIP member CRC and SHA-256
all exact parity and tie selections
all summary counts, sums and comparator ratios
limitations: Input/kernel timing itself is not rerun.
Float64 enclosure checks are empirical, not outward-rounded certification.
Bound counters are validated for consistency, not reconstructed from an unrecorded per-model call trace.

macOS-arm64.scope: Post-run independent receipt reconstruction; no metric or racing kernels rerun.

data_provenance.scope: Post-run provenance reconciliation added after benchmark start; not preregistration.
checks: actual ZIP member CRC and SHA-256
frozen hashes and complete source set
every pruned model below the exact best beyond tie tolerance
finite whole-call timings and exact medians
limitations: Floating-point checks are numerical, not directed-rounding proofs.
Initial per-model width IDs and timing-order trace are not recorded.
An early_winner flag need not imply fewer evaluated widths.
